visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a group of five anthropomorphic, animated cats standing in a school courtyard. They are dressed in black graduation gowns with yellow sashes and mortarboard caps. One orange tabby in the center holds a bouquet of flowers. The background shows a multi-story school building under bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera captures the cats jumping into the air in a synchronized celebratory dance. The movements are fluid and energetic, with one calico cat in the background leaping particularly high. The surrounding environment remains a sunlit outdoor area with blurred architectural details. (3) The composition shifts to a smaller group of three cats, two of which are holding white helium balloons while performing a rhythmic stepping motion. Their paws are visible as they move, and their facial expressions are wide-eyed and joyful. (4) A wide shot depicts dozens of graduation caps being tossed into the air simultaneously, creating a dense field of black mortarboards falling over a large crowd of feline graduates. The lighting remains consistent and bright. (5) The video concludes with the cats walking in a procession toward the camera, each holding a colorful bouquet of flowers. The depth of field is shallow, keeping the front row of cats in sharp focus while the school building and additional students fade into the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic pop track featuring a bright synthesizer melody and a heavy, percussive electronic drum beat at 128 BPM. Simultaneously, high-pitched, stylized 'meow' sound effects are introduced as a lead rhythmic element, mimicking a cheerful chant. (2) A sharp transition in the meow pattern occurs, with rapid-fire vocalizations that follow the syncopation of the BGM. The spectral brightness is high, emphasizing the sharp transients of the sound effects and the crispness of the synth track. (3) The mix becomes denser as layered cat meows create a simulated 'crowd cheering' effect, while the underlying beat maintains a consistent, strong pulse with low harmonic tension. (4) The track reaches a peak intensity with multiple overlapping sound effects representing the visual action, followed by a brief decrescendo and a final sustained synthetic note as the music loops.
